protocol.purpose: Estimate repeatable added value over simpler borrowing and justify retained decisions
protocol.dataset_roles: equal core evaluation scope; no primary corpus chosen from outcome rankings

masking.query_removal: all occurrences of every hidden type

final_nmf.inference: original posts with learned dictionary fixed

protocol.borrowed_evidence: complete normalized donor word distributions; equal offered shares; unavailable shares return to receiver
protocol.scoring: hidden-token-share times hidden gain minus visible-token-share times visible loss
protocol.preprocessing: unchanged audited counts, vocabulary and original post records; language-specific tokenizers and frozen encoders retained

control_definitions.nmf_original: No borrowing; five final seeds per corpus/K reused, not refitted per mask.
control_definitions.nmf_similarity: Original full-receiver cosine ranking of the masked-view candidate union; top three at cap without admission.
control_definitions.full_pool_loo: Original hidden-word full-pool leave-one-out removal utility, top three at cap without positive threshold.
control_definitions.proposed: ORIGINAL PEBR: hidden-word gain with downside penalty and four positive budget fractions; complete-group forward search.
control_definitions.preserve_forward_fixed_cap: REVISED PEBR: receiver-preserving score, downside penalty and complete-group forward search; only cap is a positive offer.
control_definitions.matched_preserve_fixed: Similarity-ranked available donors match revised PEBR actual transfer mass and contributing donor count for EACH receiver.
control_definitions.preserve_fixed_prefix: Same revised score, cap and no-borrowing option; score reciprocal-rank prefixes of lengths 1..3.
control_definitions.weighted_hidden_fixed: Remove only the visible-loss term; retain hidden-token-share weighting, downside utility and fixed cap.
control_definitions.preserve_fixed_no_downside: Only downside lambda becomes zero; revised score, fixed cap and group search retained.
control_definitions.preserve_fixed_individual: Average singleton revised gains at the same offered cap; actual-mixture audit without reranking/rejection.
control_definitions.preserve_fixed_single_view: View 0 and its list only; changes BOTH retrieval coverage and predictive scoring views.

metrics.reference: same original unaugmented corpus within each language; borrowed counts excluded

aggregation.unit: Mean per-post average log-probability gain within each protected bank
aggregation.outer_repeats: PRIMARY: mean/SD across four fresh protected banks; SECONDARY: all five including the previously used bank 2712
aggregation.fitting_seeds: No final topic models are fitted; final-model seeds are not audit replicates
aggregation.paired: Same target words, query cohort, folds, predictor and permitted donor catalogue for every policy
aggregation.uncertainty: Overlapping word holdouts on the same corpus; SD is not a confidence interval

protocol.timing: separate reference fitting, masked retrieval, selection, final fitting and reporting; include total cost
protocol.baseline_configuration_review: separate later-stage study; source preservation and finite training do not establish adequate tuning
protocol.annotations: not used in borrowing or topic fitting; no synthetic Chinese service labels
protocol.historical_K16: retained with original version; not relabelled and not part of the new core grid
protocol.disclosure: Existing corpus outcomes at K=8/12 have been examined; this is a prespecified revision, not blind confirmation
protocol.outcome_policy: retain every declared condition; no score-based seed/corpus deletion; simplify or narrow claims when warranted
protocol.inferential_scope: Prediction on protected receiver word types with fixed fold-excluded predictors; not final-model or new-corpus performance.
protocol.selection_score: hidden-token-share times hidden gain minus visible-token-share times visible loss
later_validation_pending: method-dependent table, figure and case regeneration
